assertions.description: A fresh G1 workspace starts with a direct machine-identity form before any document controls appear.
All four G1 views address the user directly and state the next action in plain Italian.
Ambiguous terms expose accessible information on hover or keyboard focus without activating their parent fields.
Upload, association confirmation and decision modification preserve the user scroll position.
An accepted structured source ends G1 with File pronto, explains that it has no PDF pages and marks row processing as G2.
The confirmed machine visibly exposes brand, model, serial number and machine type while internal identifiers stay collapsed.
The document upload explains PDF, CSV, XLSX, JSON and JSONL and defines the four document types.
Opening an accepted PDF shows a disabled analysis-in-progress state, then focuses and scrolls to the automatic page proposal.
The PDF page proposal can be approved above the compact page controls without scrolling through the whole document.
The flow keeps Pagine active until scope approval, then activates Controllo.
The accounting view exposes five page choices, explained outcome metrics and zero elements without an outcome.
Upload failures explain what stayed unchanged and what the user can do next.
